summary: Under Root ruling 4 of 2026-11-02 (FS-GG/.github#4818), with intent recorded first (issuecomment-6570562710), one authenticated read-only GET of Actions artifact 12838338215 (Rendering release run 40737624380 attempt 1, producer 4ede04be66cedffc8551cd14045bab714aa358a7) returned 15,375,023 bytes with SHA-256 baaa17b807bd52c9297dafbfd9161ec84fec4842317bb1f5df4e3d40d837c8bf and 20 members (19 nupkg plus release-custody.json). It took one attempt, with no retry. The manifest is 373,040 bytes with SHA-256 89ea6424cae4d06969f0a60394679e9892bd2b873fb46ebd281aa10616809720, equal to the typed plan's rendering.custodySha256. The unchanged join (current-composition-local.py --custody-evidence --rendering-source --published-all on clean main 858b624a, which calls the producer's own release-custody.py verify and compare) accepts the 19 archives and bound release plan 4bcbb1c7...; it matches Scene, KeyboardInput and SvgBrowser payload-exact. An unauthenticated public-feed read on 2026-11-02 (a dated observation) found all 19 published archives payload-exact: each is its custody archive plus one .signature.p7s entry (+13,089 or +13,090 bytes). The same run was 39/39 on the published Workspace.Template 0.20.1 route with actualProducerCustodyReadback true. The independent reviewer recomputed the retained hashes exactly. As for 0.32.3 (templates/producer-custody-readback-4ec6eaf), typed package hashes are the signed feed bytes and custody rows the pre-signing archives, so equality is at payload-entry level and the two hashes are never equated. Limits: not installed adoption or whole #4818; the retained bytes live in a private root and are not reproducible without the same credentialed access. Results are in #4818 issuecomment-6570632693.
title: Rendering 0.32.4 producer custody was read once and joins all 19 published archives at payload level
